scope_statement: Define a transparent, reproducible literature review and framework for platform market analysis.
must_cover: Define clear search terms across platform market mechanisms
Establish inclusion and exclusion criteria aligned with mechanisms
Synthesize literature into dimensions: network effects, multi-homing, governance
Operationalize dimensions using publicly available indicators and documents
Select a case platform based on data availability for analysis
should_cover: Discuss measurement methods for network effects and multi-homing
Map governance features: rules, rankings, access controls, enforcement
Assess pricing structures, fees, commissions, and monetization choices
Outline reproducibility and transparency documentation for the review
must_avoid: Unrelated platform theory not informing the framework
Purely technical system architecture or software design discussions
Anecdotal evidence without systematic methodology or empirical support
main_query: platform markets literature review network effects multi-homing governance pricing competition
facet_queries: platform governance rules rankings access control study
switching costs measurement in platform markets
monetization fees commissions pricing strategies platforms
price structure and platform competition analysis
operationalization user growth provider growth metrics
case selection Airbnb Uber eBay app store data
scoring_guidance: Score sources on (1) relevance to defined dimensions, (2) methodological rigor, (3) empirical evidence and data availability, (4) recency and citation impact, and (5) transparency enabling reproducibility.
